description: Seasonal trails for snowmobile use. Managed under agreement with the local snowmobile club. Trail fees are in effect when the trails are groomed. Visit https://ferniesnowmobile.com/ for more information about this and other local riding areas.
directions: From Sparwood travel east on Hwy 3 until you reach the Byron Creek Mine Road. Turn right and travel on this road until you reach Coal Mountain Mine. Turn right on the Corbin Creek FSR. Parking is provided on the right.
title: Corbin Creek
